notes: Tutorial keymap (docs/TUTORIAL-CLI.md): JIS 109-key board, Eisu (the 'Caps Lock / 英数' key) <-> Left Ctrl swap. Same key order as test-keymap-jis.json (KLE 'JP 109' preset order, 109 slots, no separate KC_ZKHK slot -- see that file's notes); calibrate with --calibrate-simple <UniqIdHex> 109. Single layer. On a JIS keyboard the Eisu key sends the same scancode as US CapsLock (0x3A), so its keycode is KC_CAPSLOCK. Every key is native pass-through except position 60 (physical Eisu) = KC_LCTRL and position 94 (physical Left Ctrl) = KC_CAPSLOCK.
